# Small business marketing guide: ideas and strategies

Learn how small business marketing can help you attract customers, increase sales, and grow your business.

![A small business owner marketing their business ](</content/dam/xero/pilot-images/guides/marketing/Marketing-Competitor Analysis-Hero.1646877611815.png>)

Written by Kari Brummond—Content Writer, Accountant, IRS Enrolled Agent. [Read Kari's full bio](https://www.xero.com/us/authors/kari-brummond/)

_Published Monday 20 April 2026_

## Table of contents

*   [What is small business marketing?](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/small-business-marketing/#what-is-small-business-marketing)
    
*   [Types of small business marketing](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/small-business-marketing/#types-of-small-business-marketing)
    
*   [How to create a marketing plan](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/small-business-marketing/#how-to-create-a-marketing-plan)
    
*   [10 small business marketing ideas](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/small-business-marketing/#10-small-business-marketing-ideas)
    
*   [Xero helps manage your marketing with confidence](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/small-business-marketing/#xero-helps-manage-your-marketing-with-confidence)
    
*   [FAQs on small business marketing](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/small-business-marketing/#faqs-on-small-business-marketing)
    

## Key takeaways

*   Apply the Four Ps method (product, price, promotion, and place) when developing your marketing strategy to ensure you address all essential elements that influence customer purchasing decisions.
    
*   Combine [digital marketing channels](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/digital-marketing-for-small-businesses/) like social media, email marketing, and SEO with traditional methods such as direct mail and local events to maximize your reach while staying within budget constraints.
    
*   Create a structured marketing plan by defining clear goals, identifying your target audience, setting a budget, and [tracking performance metrics](https://www.xero.com/us/accounting-software/run-financial-reports/track-business-performance/) so you can adjust your approach based on real data.
    
*   Use word-of-mouth marketing and user-generated content by implementing referral programs, encouraging customer reviews, and partnering with local businesses to amplify your marketing efforts cost-effectively.
    

## What is small business marketing?

**Small business marketing** is the strategic promotion of your products or services to attract new customers and retain existing ones. This process helps you:

*   **Connect with target customers** through cost-effective channels
    
*   **Showcase your unique value** to stand out from competitors
    
*   [Grow revenue](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/how-to-increase-sales/) using budget-friendly, measurable tactics
    

Effective marketing campaigns often focus on the [Four Ps method](https://blog.xero.com/us/news-events/small-business-marketing-introducing-the-four-ps/):

*   **Product:** meet customer needs with what you offer
    
*   **Price:** set affordable pricing that reflects value
    
*   **Promotion:** build awareness of your business and offerings
    
*   **Place:** make products available when and where customers need them
    

Let's look at how to market a [small business](https://www.xero.com/us/small-businesses/) through online and traditional marketing methods.

## Types of small business marketing

Small business marketing encompasses multiple channels and approaches, broadly categorized into digital and traditional methods. Each type offers unique advantages depending on your audience, budget, and business goals.

### Digital marketing

**Digital marketing** uses online channels to reach customers where they spend time. In 2025, it delivers the widest reach at the most affordable cost for small businesses, whether you run a physical store or an [online-only business](https://www.xero.com/us/guides/starting-an-online-business/).

Key digital marketing options include:

*   **Social media marketing:** Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn for brand awareness
    
*   **Email marketing:** newsletters and promotions for direct customer contact
    
*   **Search engine marketing:** SEO and paid ads to capture search traffic
    

Test different channels to identify which ones generate the best results for your specific audience and business goals.

#### Content marketing

**Content marketing** creates valuable videos, blog posts, and infographics to educate customers and generate interest in your business. This strategy works by:

*   **Building trust** through helpful, educational content
    
*   **Improving search rankings** when published on your website
    
*   **Supporting other campaigns** by fueling email and social media marketing
    
*   **Establishing expertise** in your industry or niche
    

#### Email marketing

**Email marketing** puts you in direct contact with customers through their inbox. Send cold outreach emails to prospective customers, or email existing customers to promote sales, share updates, and stay connected.

If you're trying to get the most out of your marketing budget, email can be especially effective because it can be automated and results are easy to track. Research shows that automated email workflows generate [30x higher returns](https://www.emailmonday.com/email-marketing-roi-statistics/) compared to one-off campaigns.

#### Website creation

**A business website** provides customers everything they need to know about your business: what you sell, why they should choose you, and how to connect. Turn your website into more than a static flyer of business basics. Create an engaging experience that helps visitors see how your business can solve their problems.

#### Search engine optimization

**Search engine optimization (SEO)** uses specific design elements and content strategies to help search engines find your website. SEO helps prospects discover your business through searches related to your product or service. It's often more cost-effective than paying for search ads and can be a crucial edge in competitive markets.

#### Social media

**Social media marketing** helps small businesses promote products, build brand awareness, and connect with customers. Given that 81% of consumers are [swayed by social media](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-marketing-roi-statistics/) to make spontaneous purchases, these platforms are a powerful tool for driving sales.

To reach the right audience, use the social media sites your customers use. Answer comments promptly (especially complaints) and show your personality. Social media is your space to showcase what makes your brand unique while staying true to your business values.

## An all-in-one tool for your digital marketing report

As a marketer, you probably spend your time working within a multitude of different digital spaces simultaneously: analytics tools, social media networks, emailing systems, and digital ad tools. No wonder you’ve always got 23 different tabs open in your browser and it takes you ages to create just one digital marketing report for your clients!

## ![social media marketing reports icon](https://static.dashthis.com/media/1398/icon_social.svg) Social Media Marketing Reports

Nowadays, businesses don’t really have a choice to be active on social media networks if they want to be successful. With algorithms changing everyday, it’s important to consistently track how your social media marketing efforts are faring. Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Youtube… engagement, reach, impressions… knowing where to look can be a headache. Bring it all together in one clean, easy-to-read report!

## ![SEO marketing reports icon](https://static.dashthis.com/media/1397/icon_seo.svg) SEO Marketing Reports

In the digital space, it’s all about traffic. SEO is the process of improving your web content to target the RIGHT audience and offer them exactly the information they’re looking for: in the right place, at the right time. A clear and concise SEO report is the best way to make sure your optimisation efforts are bringing you in the right direction. Following the trends in sessions, conversions, backlinks, and more, will help you make sure that you’re constantly improving your standing compared to your competitors.

## ![PPC marketing reports](https://static.dashthis.com/media/1390/icon_ppc.svg) Paid Search Marketing Reports

Sometimes, to get in front of the right audience efficiently and effectively, paid search marketing is the way to go. Whether you’re using AdWords, DoubleClick Campaign Manager, or paying for advertising on any combination of different networks, it’s important to visualize your strategy as a whole, instead of each network independently. With a centralized reporting tool, you can easily incorporate data from various platforms, analyze your results together, and optimize each channel as needed.

The hard work that goes into running a small business is anything but small. Your business may still be growing, but you can meet and exceed your goals now with the right data to back your marketing decisions. That’s why we’ve compiled this ultimate list of small business marketing statistics to help you prioritize your marketing channels, progress your strategy, and turn your small business into a big success.

### Contents

*   [Small business advertising statistics](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-statistics/#small-business-advertising-statistics)
*   [Small business social media marketing statistics](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-statistics/#small-business-marketing-social-media-statistics)
*   [Stats on small business reputation management and online presence](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-statistics/#small-business-marketing-stats)
*   [AI statistics for small businesses](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-statistics/#small-business-marketing-ai-statistics)
*   [Small business email marketing statistics](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-statistics/#small-business-email-marketing-statistics)
*   [Statistics on small business websites and live chat](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-statistics/#small-business-marketing-website-statistics)
*   [Even more small business marketing stats](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-statistics/#more-small-business-marketing-statistics)

## Small business marketing statistics: Our top five picks

Let’s kick off our list with the top [small business marketing statistics](https://www.wordstream.com/blog/ws/2022/04/19/digital-marketing-statistics) every business owner should know.

💡 **Want exclusive data on the latest small business marketing trends (including insights from over 730 real businesses)?** Download our [Small Business Marketing Trends Report for 2025](https://localiq.com/resources/smb-marketing-trends-report/?cid=Web_LiQ_Any_InContent_Guide_2025SmallBusinessMarketingTrendsReport_Download)!

### The [top three](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-trends-report/) marketing channels small businesses currently use are social media marketing, social media advertising, and search advertising.

52% of small businesses use social media marketing, followed by 47% using social media ads, and 40% using search ads—according to our [Small Business Marketing Trends Report](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-trends-report/).

![Chart that shows 2025 small business marketing trends report marketing strategies and tactics SMBs are currently investing in](//localiq.com/wp-content/plugins/a3-lazy-load/assets/images/lazy_placeholder.gif)

### Only [21%](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-trends-report/) of small businesses have a marketing team of five or more employees.

Most small businesses are relying on a smaller dedicated marketing team.

![Chart that shows 2025 small business marketing trends report number of employees dedicated to marketing](//localiq.com/wp-content/plugins/a3-lazy-load/assets/images/lazy_placeholder.gif)

### Almost two-thirds of small businesses say customer referrals are their best source for customer acquisition.

However, digital marketing and [online advertising](https://www.wordstream.com/online-advertising) also topped the list at 50%.

![Chart that shows 2025 small business marketing trends report that shows best sources for customer acquisition](//localiq.com/wp-content/plugins/a3-lazy-load/assets/images/lazy_placeholder.gif)

### About [47%](https://www.businessdasher.com/small-business-online-marketing-statistics/) of small business owners do all of their own marketing.

When it comes to managing your marketing, you don’t have to do it all alone. Many businesses also leverage a marketing partner to alleviate the hard work that goes into making marketing great.

### Almost half of all small businesses ([48%](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-marketing-trends-report/)) think economic uncertainty will be somewhat or very challenging in the coming year.

This [common small business challenge](https://localiq.com/blog/small-business-challenges/) is followed by getting new leads and customers and making budgets stretch.

![Chart that shows 2025 small business marketing trends report biggest challenges for SMBs](//localiq.com/wp-content/plugins/a3-lazy-load/assets/images/lazy_placeholder.gif)
